'''Biological science droids''' were one of the four primary subgroups of [[Class one droid/Legends|class one droid]]s, along with [[physical science droid]]s and [[mathematics droid]]s. Biological science [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were designed for and tasked with the study of biological life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The widely-used [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] group was in fact a subgroup of biological science droids, but due to their prominence they were often listed separately in droid catalogs.
